title: Correct initial flux
description: Essential: Student calculates Φ₁ = B·S = 2×10⁻³ Wb with correct area (0.01 m²).

title: Correct 60° flux
description: Essential: Student calculates Φ₂ = B·S·cos60° = 1×10⁻³ Wb using correct angle.

title: Correct 180° flux change
description: Essential: Student calculates ΔΦ = 2B·S = 4×10⁻³ Wb, recognizing flux reversal.

title: Area calculation
description: Important: Student converts side length to meters and computes area S = L² correctly.

title: Flux formula application
description: Important: Student uses Φ = B·A·cosθ appropriately for each rotation scenario.

title: Angle interpretation
description: Important: Student correctly identifies θ as angle between B and normal to coil plane.

title: Sign error in change
description: Pitfall: Student calculates ΔΦ = 0 or uses wrong sign by treating 180° rotation as no net change.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows unit conversion (cm→m) and reports flux in webers.
